g.text: 1) Schedule a job based on a certain schedule and see the status of the job

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Scheduling: When a user creates a job, the Scheduler Plane (job_service) saves the job

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: details and its next_execution_time in a database (like Cassandra). A master-worker setup

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: (scheduling_service) checks this schedule every minute. When a job's time arrives, the workers

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: push the task into a message queue (like a Kafka topic).

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Seeing Status: The Execution Plane is responsible for status updates. As the

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: execution_service processes the task, it updates the Task_Execution_History database

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: table, changing the job's status from SCHEDULED to RUNNING, and finally to COMPLETED
